caption:
Back at work after the break and your rehab exercises have quietly disappeared? Mr Turtle knows the feeling.

Most people find it hard to keep exercises going once the week fills up. The good news is that short, regular sessions usually work better than long ones you keep putting off.

Try stacking exercises onto things you already do, booking rehab into your calendar like a meeting and keeping a band at your desk. Ask which two or three exercises matter most right now. If your program doesn't fit your life, tell us so we can adjust it.

Our team at Hybrid Physio is happy to help. Book online via the link in bio
